description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.
